title: Representability of pro-etale local systems of sets
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], with small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ in the universes of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on this site. Suppose that there is a pro-etale covering family $\{U_i\to X\}_i$ and sets $S_i$ such that $F|_{U_i}$ is isomorphic to the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value $S_i$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then there exist a scheme $Z$, an etale morphism $q:Z\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], and bijections $\theta_U:F(U)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_X(U,Z)$ natural in all objects $U\to X$ of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$. The morphism $q$ has the following valuation lifting property. For every valuation ring $R$ [def-trf-valuation-ring] with fraction field $K$, every morphism $b:\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$, and every $X$-morphism $a:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Z$ over the restriction of $b$, there is a unique $X$-morphism $\widetilde a:\operatorname{Spec}R\to Z$ whose restriction to $\operatorname{Spec}K$ is $a$. No finiteness or nonemptiness condition is imposed on the sets $S_i$ or on $Z$.

source.place: Definition 7.3.1(1),(3), p. 66; Lemma 7.3.9 (Loc_X = Cov_X), pp. 67-68, implication Loc_X to Cov_X. The locally Noetherian hypothesis is a specialization of the locally topologically Noetherian standing hypothesis of Section 7.3.

proof.text: Apply the arbitrary-set locally constant clause to obtain an etale sheaf G and F ≅ ν*G.

Apply the size-explicit realization theorem to G. It realizes its comparison inverse image over the canonical enlarged X and supplies actual local coproduct identifications from every given trivialization.

On a coproduct of copies of B, use the clopen description of maps to the coproduct. Connected valuation spectra select one summand; the map through that summand is the unique valuative lift. On the self-pullback the diagonal is precisely the equal-label clopen locus, hence a closed immersion. Empty sheet sets give no generic map.

Evaluate CoversTop at the identity pro-etale object and extract a precoverage refinement using the Mathlib characterization of generated covering sieves. Its arrows factor through the displayed family. QuasiCompactCover.of_hom and flatness of weakly etale maps prove this original family fpqc, with joint surjectivity transported through the refinement. Apply the separate universe-enlargement theorem to this fpqc family. Transport the local coproduct properties to the local presheaves, using Yoneda preservation of pullbacks and closed-immersion base-change stability. Apply fpqc descent to get separatedness and full valuative lifting for E.

Identify the pullback over the terminal presheaf with the product, and apply the separated-etale-space schemehood theorem. Compose the natural functor-of-points isomorphisms; Yoneda naturality transports full existence and uniqueness of valuative lifts to the representing scheme.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 7.3.9 Loc_X to Cov_X, with Stacks 0GF6 size footnote and canonical affine universe transport explicit. Lean coproduct and presheaf transport arguments by F6.
